description: Synthetic MedOrbits roles and permissions for local development and automated authorization tests. Production authorization must be enforced by the server.

roles.name: user
roles.description: Standard registered applicant or platform user.

roles.name: counsellor
roles.description: Counsellor with access to assigned applicant records and admissions workflows.

roles.name: employer
roles.description: Employer permitted to manage their own recruitment listings.

roles.name: admin
roles.description: Administrative role for authorized platform operations.
